rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that gives a false impression or leads people to the wrong conclusion.

example.english: This advertisement claims it can cure every illness, so it is really misleading.
example.traditional: 呢個廣告講到包醫百病，真係誤導人嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gwong2 gou3 gong2 dou3 baau1 ji1 baak3 beng6 zan1 hai6 ng6 dou6 jan4 ge3

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on something being liable to cause misunderstanding rather than deliberately deceiving people.

example.english: Writing the headline like that is liable to be misleading.
example.traditional: 你咁樣寫個標題，好容易令人誤會嘅。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 joeng2 se2 go3 biu1 tai4 hou2 jung4 ji6 ling6 jan4 ng6 wui6 ge3
